_meta.description: Fantomon skill texts from the eog.gg database tab (13 Fantomons): rarity and each passive and technique with its description. Rows are marked by eog as taken from Prydwen. Rarity mapping: Rainbow = Mythic, SSR = Legendary, SR = Epic (assumed from the gem and relic ladders).

skills.name: Radiant Sanctuary
skills.description: At the start of battle, grants the character Guardian Angel for 3 turns. When this status expires, restores 50% of their lost HP and grants them Power Unsealed for the entire battle.

skills.name: Radiant Halo
skills.description: Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Light DMG once to all enemies within a 1-grid square area around the target grid, with a 50% base chance to inflict Taunt for 2 turns.

skills.name: Divine Retribution
skills.description: Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Light DMG once to all enemies within a 1-grid square area around the target grid, with a 50% base chance to inflict Retribution for 2 turns.

skills.name: Bright Conviction
skills.description: Reduces DMG taken from Taunted enemies.

skills.name: Armor Protection
skills.description: Grants 1 stack of DEF Up at the end of the caster's turn. At 3 stacks, removes all stacks to grant a shield based on the caster's DEF.

skills.name: Dash
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster.

skills.name: Heavy Protection
skills.description: Grants a shield based on the Fantomon's DEF to the owner within 2 grids of the caster, lasting 2 turns.

skills.name: Mountain Protection
skills.description: Triggers when the caster cumulatively loses 15% of max HP, granting a shield based on the caster's DEF. Can trigger up to 5 times per battle.

skills.name: Crash
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster.

skills.name: Mountain Charge
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster, with a 100% base chance to knock them back by 1 grid.

skills.name: Just a Kitty?
skills.description: Chomusuke instinctively provides support. When a character casts a damaging Technique on enemy targets, Chomusuke enables the character to launch an extra attack, dealing Physical DMG once to all enemies within 1 grid of a hit target , with a 50% base chance to reduce their DEF by 15% for 1 turn. Can trigger only once per turn.

skills.name: Golden Flash
skills.description: When a damaging Technique is used on enemies, deals Physical DMG once to one of the targets and all enemies 1 grid around.

skills.name: Golden Feather
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 4 grids of the caster.

skills.name: Golden Storm
skills.description: Selects a grid within 4 grids of the caster. Deals Physical DMG 3 times to all enemies within a 1-grid square area around the target grid.

skills.name: Emergency Aid
skills.description: If the caster starts a turn with HP below 80%, heals the caster once, with a 50% chance to randomly dispel 1 status ailment or debuff.

skills.name: Quick Fix
skills.description: Heals 1 ally within 2 grids of the caster once.

skills.name: Cure All
skills.description: Heals the owner within 2 grids of the caster once, and grants 1 random buff (+10% ATK, +10% DEF, or +10% SPD) to them for 1 turn.

skills.name: Purging Spell
skills.description: When a damaging Technique is used on enemies, deals Water DMG once to one of the targets and randomly dispels 1 buff. Can trigger only once per turn.

skills.name: Water Orb
skills.description: Deals Water DMG once to 1 enemy within 4 grids of the caster.

skills.name: Water Drill
skills.description: Deals Water DMG once to all enemies in a 1x4 grid area in front of the caster, with a 50% base chance to reduce their DEF by 20% for 2 turns.

skills.name: Natural Power
skills.description: When a Technique is used on allies, heals 1 target once.

skills.name: Flying Leaf
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG once to 1 enemy within 4 grids of the caster.

skills.name: Wakening of Vitality
skills.description: Heals 1 ally (caster excluded) within 4 grids of the caster once.

skills.name: Requiem Blast
skills.description: When a damaging Technique is used on enemies, deals Dark DMG once to one of the targets and all enemies 2 grids around, with a 100% chance to inflict 1 stack of 10% DEF Reduction (max 3 stacks) for 2 turns. Can trigger only twice every 2 turns. (Large targets may take multiple hits.)

skills.name: Shadow Sweep
skills.description: Deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within a 3x2 grid area in front of the caster.

skills.name: Nightshade Blast
skills.description: Deals Dark DMG once to 1 enemy within 2 grids of the caster. For every 5% HP lost by an enemy, this skill deals 5% more DMG to that enemy, up to a max of 50% increase. Skill cooldown resets upon materialization.

skills.name: Death Star Scatter
skills.description: Killing an enemy deals additional Dark DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the target.

skills.name: Ink Burst
skills.description: At the start of battle, reduces the CD of all Techniques by 1 turn for the character, and grants a DMG Boost for the entire battle.

skills.name: Bamboo Gale
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 4 grids of the caster, with a 50% chance to deal 1.5x DMG.

skills.name: Verdant Spikes
skills.description: Selects a target within 4 grids of the caster, and deals Physical DMG once to all enemies within a 1-grid square area of that target, with a 100% base chance to inflict Fragility for 1 turn.

skills.name: Emerald Dew
skills.description: Heals allies within 4 grids of the caster once at turn start. (If an ally is within multiple Emerald Dew ranges from Pandarial, only the newest effect applies.)

skills.name: Wind Embrace
skills.description: Increases the caster's ATK and SPD for 1 turn after the caster's turn ends.

skills.name: Glow Glob
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG once to 1 enemy within 4 grids of the caster.

skills.name: Slow Wind Shot
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG once to 1 enemy within 4 grids of the caster, with a 60% base chance to delay the target's action by 15%.

skills.name: Sandstone Shot
skills.description: When a damaging Technique is used on enemies, deals Physical DMG once to one of the targets, with a 50% base chance to reduce their ATK by 25% for 1 turn. Can trigger only once per turn.

skills.name: Tail Lash
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster.

skills.name: Falling Sand
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG once to all enemies within a 3x2 grid area in front of you, with a 50% base chance to reduce their DMG by 15% for 2 turns.

skills.name: Lotus Step
skills.description: When a damaging Technique is used on enemies, deals Light DMG once to one of the targets and all enemies 1 grid around, knocking them airborne. Can trigger only twice every 2 turns. (Deals 20% more DMG to large targets.)

skills.name: Aura Shot
skills.description: Deals Light DMG once to 1 enemy within 4 grids of the caster. (Deals 20% more DMG to large targets.)

skills.name: Bolt from the Blue
skills.description: Selects a grid within 6 grids of the caster. Deals Light DMG once to all enemies within a 1-grid square area around the target grid and knocks them airborne. (Deals 20% more DMG to large targets.)
